No. 2054/24 – MONDAY JANUARY 15, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Amended Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. : NCP/HG/L02/343 (VII).
Land and Land Development Ministry’s Ref. No.:

I, Rajapaksha Mohottige Dona Priyadarshani Pushpa Kumari, Divisional Secretary, Hingurakgoda do hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that actions are taken in respect of acquisition of land for the extension of the Hingurakgoda Air Force Camp as mentioned in the Gazeette No. 1782/38 dated 02.11.2012 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.
Description of the lands to be acquired :

It is hereby notified that Lots No. 5, 7, 8, 9 and 10 depicted in the Advanced Tracing POHG/2002/865 dated 28.02.2003 prepared by the Superintendent of Survey, Polonnaruwa, located in Sinhala Pattuwa in the Hingurakgoda Divisional Secretary’s Division in the Polonnaruwa District shall be re-amended as follows.
Lot No. 05 - Name of Land: Hingurakdamana - Description: In extent 1.286 Hectare out of land claimed by Ganege Ralalage Dingiri Amma of Warahena, Hingurakgoda and bounded as,
On the North by: Land claimed by B. M. Kalubanda and Road, on the East by: Road, on the South by: Road and

Lot No. 06, on the West by: Land claimed by Air Force Camp (in extent 02 Roods is claimed upon the Grant bearing No. PO/G/HINGU/5612 and the remaining portion is the State land encroached and cultivated by Dingiri Amma.)
Lot No. 07 - Name of Land: Hingurakdamana - Description: In extent 0.909 Hectare out of land claimed by Darawa Kumbure Gedara Dayarathna of No.16, Kumaragama, Hingurakgoda and bounded as,
